secondary_questions: Does any partial-evidence condition degrade relative to L0?

cohort.position_recurrence: x[t] = clamp( (x[t-1] + signed_speed*dt) + noise[t] ), iterative, binary64
cohort.candidate_index_bound_rationale: Raised from 200 to 2000 by Authority Amendment 2 (v1.5). The superseded 200 was justified by an expected requirement of ~14-16 candidates per direction, but that expectation was calibrated on historical A-prime between-identity label diversity, which was produced largely by the target-window phase offsets [0,3,6,9,12] that section 2.5 prospectively removes. Without those offsets every identity's target window anchors at the same counterfactual occlusion onset, between-identity label spread collapses (measured onset spread 0.266 blocks LTR / 0.345 RTL versus A-prime's 1.27 / 1.38), and gate 9 rejects far more candidates than the calibration anticipated. The 200 bound was therefore an incorrectly calibrated feasibility ceiling, not evidence that gate 9 is wrong. Measured under the amended rules the cohort completes at candidate index 460 (LTR) and 328 (RTL). The 2000 ceiling was selected prospectively, before the extended candidates were inspected, and is deliberately not set to the observed last-needed index. Exhausting it remains a genuine terminal signal, not ordinary scanning.

all_q_qualification_gate.name: ALL_Q_PROSPECTIVE_QUALIFICATION
all_q_qualification_gate.statement: A candidate is admitted to the III-A production cohort only if it independently satisfies the PER-CANDIDATE gates of section 2.4 (gates 1-8, 10, 11) at EVERY frozen III-B q level, each evaluated on that (identity,q) cell's OWN path regenerated from the identity seed with the identical frozen arithmetic. Gate 9 is peer-dependent and is evaluated once on the production cohort at the III-A q = 0.05.
all_q_qualification_gate.resume_rule: A1 only, and only while no capture of any kind exists. Regeneration reruns the identical deterministic procedure end to end and reproduces the same cohort unless an implementation defect was repaired; the repair and the resulting cohort delta are recorded in the receipt. Once any capture exists, regeneration is forbidden and is a section 9.2 amendment.
all_q_qualification_gate.why_this_gate_is_ordered_before_material: The observed per-identity all-q qualification rate is 0.9575, so the probability that at least one of 25 independently admitted identities fails the all-q requirement is 1 - 0.9575**25 = 0.661. Evaluating the requirement after the cohort was materialized would therefore fail about two runs in three and would leave B-GEN with no admissible recovery other than cohort regeneration - forbidden once any capture exists, and never permitted on the basis of an outcome. Ordering the gate before materialization removes the failure mode entirely at zero scientific cost.
all_q_qualification_gate.expected_admission_cost: Gate 12 tightens admission by roughly a factor of 0.9575 per candidate. It changes WHICH candidates are admitted; it changes no frozen scientific value, no estimand, no condition, no readout and no statistic.
all_q_qualification_gate.scope: Gate 12 evaluates the PER-CANDIDATE gates - gates 1-8, 10 and 11 - at every binding q, each on that (identity,q) cell's own regenerated path. Gate 9 (between-identity diversity) is peer-dependent, has no well-defined per-candidate rate, and is evaluated ONCE on the production cohort at the III-A q = 0.05. Gate 9's threshold remains exactly 0.10 blocks and remains binding in full on the admitted cohort. This is the scope authority section 18.4 already used: its 100.0% rate at q = 0.0125 and its identification of gate 3 as the dominant high-q rejection are only definable with gate 9 outside the per-q evaluation.

fir.normalization: MANDATORY AND FROZEN: normalized_kernel[k] = taps[k] / math.fsum(taps), accumulated with math.fsum. Taps are nonnegative (RIGHT_TO_LEFT tap 8 is the exact float -0.0 and is treated as +0.0). Normalization is applied ONCE, at load, before any label construction, any H(m), any S(tau), any gbar and any oracle quantity. Unnormalized taps are forbidden.
fir.label_formula: label[t] = sum_{lag} taps[lag] * position[t-lag]; require t - len(taps) + 1 >= 0

p0_rve.name: ROBUST_VISUAL_EVIDENCE

measurement_scope_disclosure.statement: RVE measures SOURCE-RENDERED VISUAL EVIDENCE: the linear-light energy of the present-minus-absent residual in the 640x360 sRGB frames produced by the Minecraft client. It is not, and does not claim to be, the model's perceptual or representational metric.
measurement_scope_disclosure.consequence: The historical MineWorld preprocessing path is documented as BGR-ordered. Channel order does not change the RVE statistic, because the masked squared residual is the sum of squared per-channel differences and is invariant to any permutation of the channel axis. It does mean that RVE and the model's own front end need not weight the scene identically, so the RVE ladder orders CONDITIONS BY SOURCE VISUAL EVIDENCE, not by model-perceived evidence.
measurement_scope_disclosure.required_manuscript_disclosure: The graded ladder L1 > L2 > L3 is calibrated on source-rendered visual evidence. The evidence coordinate O_c is therefore an apparatus-side measurement of scene degradation, not a measurement of what the model perceives. Claims must be phrased over the source evidence coordinate.

p0_rve.noise: N(c,p,b) = same masked energy between deterministic split-half absent-frame medians (first half vs second half by ascending capture index)
p0_rve.selection_rule: minimize squared distance to selection_targets; tie-break lexicographically earliest triple by registry ID (L1 then L2 then L3)

A3_REMOTE_OBJECT_STORE.why: Remote object storage has no meaningful LOCAL free-space bound and must not be treated as a local disk gate. A3 instead verifies reachability, a write/read-back round trip by hash, and available quota if the provider exposes one.

B_GATE_III_B_INCREMENTAL.why: The launch gate fires AFTER A3 and after III-A capture, when III-A's footprint already exists. The correct quantity there is REMAINING headroom for III-B's INCREMENTAL footprint, not the whole-program peak. The whole-program preflight belongs to A3 and has already been enforced.
B_GATE_III_B_INCREMENTAL.superseded_reason: 20 GiB was incoherent with the A3 combined gate. A host passing A3 at exactly 64 GiB has only 15.204 GiB free when this gate fires, so it would have been forced to a spurious CLEAN_SKIP despite A3 having been sized for the combined program. Corrected to 15 GiB, which is <= the 15.204 GiB structural headroom.

storage.therefore_A3_uses: A3_COMBINED_PROGRAM_WITH_LOCAL_MIRROR or A3_COMBINED_PROGRAM_NO_LOCAL_MIRROR according to the recorded durability mode; the III-A-only gates are unreachable in this program because A3 always precedes B-GATE, so III-B can never be terminally skipped before A3 runs.
A3_records: POOL_WORKING device id and free bytes
POOL_DURABLE mode and, if local, its device id and free bytes
POOL_SCRATCH device id and whether it is a distinct pool
the gate actually applied and its byte threshold
whether a local durability mirror is enabled

gate_coherence_invariant.why_A3_was_not_raised: III-A is mandatory and III-B is optional. Raising the mandatory A3 threshold to protect an optional module would make III-A harder to start in order to make III-B easier to finish - exactly the wrong trade. The optional gate was lowered to fit the structural headroom instead.
gate_coherence_invariant.derivation: MAX_III_A_STORAGE_SHARE = whole-program mirrored peak (59.304 GiB) - III-B incremental mirrored peak (10.508 GiB) = 48.796 GiB. Headroom at the B-GATE = A3 gate (64) - 48.796 = 15.204 GiB.

time_quantity_definitions.purpose: Four quantities that repair pass 1 conflated. They are never interchangeable.
time_quantity_definitions.TOTAL_TASK_EFFORT_HOURS: Human-equivalent developer effort to build a task and its tests. A sum of effort. It is NOT elapsed wall clock and must never be compared directly against the calendar.
time_quantity_definitions.SERIAL_CRITICAL_PATH_ELAPSED_HOURS: Wall clock actually consumed by ONE agent session executing the A1/A2 tasks in dependency order. This is the quantity the calendar spends, and the quantity the schedule uses. It is the SUM over the selected task set, not the dependency critical path, because every A1 task is repository-exclusive and single-session.
time_quantity_definitions.DEPENDENCY_CRITICAL_PATH_HOURS: Longest dependency chain by elapsed time. A theoretical FLOOR that would need multiple parallel agents on separate worktrees. Recorded for reference; NOT used by the schedule, because parallel repository mutation is forbidden.
time_quantity_definitions.OPERATOR_ATTENDED_HOURS: Human attention: review, approval, rig operation, display-attached capture. Much smaller than either effort or elapsed, because implementation is agent-driven.
time_quantity_definitions.UNATTENDED_COMPUTE_HOURS: Production capture and GPU extraction, which run without an operator and consume wall clock without consuming attended hours.
time_quantity_definitions.relationship: SERIAL_ELAPSED is the primitive, summed per task. TOTAL_TASK_EFFORT = SERIAL_ELAPSED * AGENT_COMPRESSION_FACTOR (exactly 2.0). THAT FACTOR IS AN ASSUMPTION AND THE DOMINANT SCHEDULE RISK; the section 10.5 checkpoints measure observed milestones, never the factor.
time_quantity_definitions.if_the_factor_is_wrong: The checkpoints detect it: they key on observed task-completion milestones against the clock, not on the assumed factor. A factor of 1.0 - no agent speedup at all - degrades the program to the CONSERVATIVE column, which the checkpoints handle by selecting a reduced plan.

phase2_start_semantics.PHASE2_START: The instant at which the independent final audit returns PASS with IMPLEMENTATION_GO = true AND the authority package is committed and frozen. Implementation begins IMMEDIATELY at that instant.
phase2_start_semantics.superseded_assumption_defect: The prior schedule hard-coded a Monday 09:00 start. If authorization occurs earlier, waiting until Monday discards usable deadline buffer for no reason. Authorization on Sunday means implementation starts Sunday.
phase2_start_semantics.checkpoints_are_absolute_note: The section 10.5 implementation checkpoints are derived by subtracting each plan's CONSERVATIVE post-A2 tail from the absolute Thursday 20:00 deadline. They are therefore fixed instants that do not move with PHASE2_START, and they remain correct for any start.

oracle.transition: x[t+1] = x[t] + s*v*dt + w[t], w[t] ~ N(0, q*dt) i.i.d.
oracle.affine_negativity_semantics: The affine reduction sigma2_tau = q*dt*(tau + c_direction) is EXACT only for tau >= 8 and is FORBIDDEN below tau = 8. Where it is (wrongly) evaluated below tau = 8 it returns a strictly NEGATIVE variance for every integer tau in [1, affine_last_negative_tau] and a strictly POSITIVE variance for every integer tau >= affine_first_positive_tau, per direction. The boundary is direction-specific because c_LTR = -4.355500526064508 and c_RTL = -3.395856222446993, so the sign change lies at tau = -c_direction: 4.3555 for LEFT_TO_RIGHT and 3.3959 for RIGHT_TO_LEFT. There is no integer tau at which the affine form is exactly zero.
oracle.affine_threshold_authority: III_B_ORACLE_SPECIFICATION.json is the single source of these two integers; the machine authority reproduces them verbatim and the two must agree exactly.

inferential_procedure.name: III_B_FROZEN_INFERENTIAL_PROCEDURE
inferential_procedure.interval_definition: Every reported interval is an ORDINARY two-sided 95% whole-identity bootstrap PERCENTILE interval, B = 10,000, resampling identities with replacement and recomputing the entire statistic (including any ranking, residualization or fold-wise pooling) inside each replicate. Its confidence level is NOT adjusted for multiplicity and it carries no familywise guarantee. It reports effect size and direction only.
inferential_procedure.significance_definition: Significance is declared ONLY by the Holm-adjusted p-value decision below. A confidence interval never declares significance in this module.
bootstrap_inversion_algorithm: 1. Compute the observed statistic T_obs on the locked held-out predictions.
2. Draw B = 10,000 whole-identity bootstrap replicates with the frozen seed; recompute the complete statistic T_star_b inside each replicate.
3. Two-sided 95% CI = the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of {T_star_b} (linear interpolation, numpy.percentile default), reported unadjusted.
4. One-sided p-value against H0: T <= T_null is p = (1 + #{T_star_b <= T_null}) / (B + 1).
5. T_null is 0 for U2-S2, U3-S1 and U3-S2, and 1/6 for U2-S3. U2-S1 is NOT inverted: its p-value comes from the permutation null above.
6. p is clipped to [1/(B+1), 1]; it can never be exactly 0.
permutation_p_value_algorithm: Used for U2-S1 only. Permute the q_low / q_high labels WITHIN each identity across that identity's own cells, holding tau, identity, fold and every other structure fixed.
B = 9,999 permutations plus the observed statistic.
statistics_outside_every_family: the eight clock and category confound controls
holm_algorithm: 1. Collect the m p-values of the family in the frozen member order.
2. Sort ascending; ties are broken by the frozen member order (U2-S1 < U2-S2 < U2-S3; U3-S1 < U3-S2), making the ordering deterministic.
3. Adjusted p-values, step-down with monotonicity enforced: padj_(1) = min(1, m * p_(1)); padj_(k) = min(1, max(padj_(k-1), (m - k + 1) * p_(k))).
4. Map padj back to the original member order.
5. Declare a member SIGNIFICANT iff padj <= alpha = 0.05.

S1.name: MATCHED_TAU_CONTRAST
S1.estimand: mean over tau 1..15 of [sigma_hat(q_high,i,tau) - sigma_hat(q_low,i,tau)], identity-macro

S2.name: PROPOSAL_ALIGNED_CONDITIONAL_ASSOCIATION
S2.estimand: partial rank association rho(sigma_hat, sigma_oracle | tau x direction)
S2.conditioning_correction_reason: The oracle sigma depends on direction through the direction-specific FIR-derived alignment term H_direction(m): S(tau) and therefore sigma_oracle differ between LEFT_TO_RIGHT and RIGHT_TO_LEFT at equal tau. After tau-ONLY residualization the residual direction contrast survives in BOTH rank vectors, so a decoder that reads only direction - with literally zero q sensitivity - could produce a positive U2-S2. U2-S1 and U2-S3 are protected by their within-identity contrasts and needed no change; U2-S2 did.
S2.nuisance_cell_definition: tau in 1..15 crossed with direction in {LEFT_TO_RIGHT, RIGHT_TO_LEFT}
S2.ols_solver: numpy.linalg.lstsq(design, y, rcond=None) on the design [1 | 30 cell indicators]. The design is rank deficient by exactly one, so the coefficient vector is not unique, but the minimum-norm least-squares FITTED VALUES and RESIDUALS are unique and are the only quantities used.
S2.canonical_equivalent_form: The residual of a rank vector is exactly rank minus the mean of that rank vector within its own (tau, direction) cell. Implementations may use within-cell mean centring directly; it is numerically identical to the pseudoinverse fit and is the definition of record for tests.
S2.singleton_cell_rule: A (tau, direction) cell holding exactly one observation yields residual exactly 0.0 for both rank vectors and is RETAINED, not dropped. An empty cell contributes nothing.
S2.degenerate_replicate_rule: A whole-identity bootstrap replicate may contain identities of only one direction. The 30-cell centring is still well defined (the absent direction's cells are empty) and the replicate is retained. The count of single-direction replicates is reported.
S2.ranking_and_residualization_order_frozen: RANK FIRST over the pooled set, THEN residualize the ranks. Residualizing before ranking, or ranking within cells, is a different statistic and is forbidden.

negative_control_fixture.name: D11_ZERO_Q_SENSITIVITY_DIRECTION_CONFOUND_FIXTURE
negative_control_fixture.supersedes: the pure-direction fixture, which was FALSE: a decoder constant within direction yields rho|tau = -0.067, not a positive value, so the old D.11 would have failed a CORRECT implementation
negative_control_fixture.why_the_old_fixture_was_wrong: The oracle's direction ordering FLIPS with tau - LTR > RTL at tau in {1,2}, RTL > LTR for tau >= 3 - so a decoder that is constant within direction largely cancels when pooled over tau = 1..15 and produces a small NEGATIVE partial correlation. The confound is carried by the tau-by-direction INTERACTION, not by direction alone.
negative_control_fixture.formula: sigma_hat_fixture(identity, q, tau) := mean over q' in {0.0125, 0.05, 0.2} of sigma_oracle(direction(identity), q', tau).  It depends ONLY on (tau, direction). It is CONSTANT across q at fixed (identity, tau), so it carries literally zero q information.
negative_control_fixture.q_sensitivity_assertion: For every identity and every tau, sigma_hat_fixture is identical at q_low, q_mid and q_high. The test asserts this exactly (max spread across q == 0.0) before computing any statistic.
negative_control_fixture.cohort_shape: the frozen 13 LTR / 12 RTL direction split, tau = 1..15, all in-scope q
negative_control_fixture.theoretical_upper_bound_derivation: sqrt of the share of the tau-residualized oracle-rank variance explained by the tau-by-direction cell means; measured share = 0.0130.
negative_control_fixture.optional_stronger_variant: OPTIMAL_PROJECTION: sigma_hat := the (tau,direction) cell mean of the tau-residualized oracle rank vector. Also zero-q-sensitivity, attains rho|tau ~ 0.113, and is permitted as a stronger form of the same control.
required_assertions: the fixture has EXACTLY zero q sensitivity (max across-q spread == 0.0)

under tau-ONLY conditioning rho is positive and within the frozen deterministic reference 0.0905724833 +/- 0.002, and the whole-identity bootstrap 95% CI lies entirely above zero - the false-positive pathway is demonstrated
under tau-BY-DIRECTION conditioning Var(r_hat) <= TOL, so the frozen zero-variance rule fires

negative_control_fixture.tolerance_note: Bootstrap quantities are compared against reference RANGES, not exact floats. Only the zero-q-sensitivity assertion is exact.
negative_control_fixture.reference_rho_tau_only_derivation: Deterministic. Computed from the frozen construction with scipy average-rank ties, pooled over the 13 LTR / 12 RTL x 3 q x tau 1..15 = 1125 cell design. No randomness enters the observed statistic, so the tolerance covers only implementation-level rank/BLAS ordering differences.

zero_variance_rule.name: U2_S2_ZERO_VARIANCE_RESIDUAL_RULE
zero_variance_rule.why: After rank transformation and nuisance residualization the Pearson correlation is undefined (0/0) if either residual vector has no variation. This is not hypothetical: the frozen D.11 negative-control fixture is constant within every (tau, direction) cell by construction, so its residual is identically zero. Without this rule, conforming implementations disagree - numpy returns NaN with a RuntimeWarning, scipy returns NaN with a ConstantInputWarning, and a guarded implementation returns 0.0. The decision must not depend on IEEE comparison accidents such as 'NaN <= 0.05' evaluating False.
zero_variance_rule.criterion: Let r_hat and r_oracle be the residualized ranked vectors. The zero-variance case holds iff Var(r_hat) <= TOL or Var(r_oracle) <= TOL, with Var the population variance (ddof=0).
zero_variance_rule.tolerance_definition: TOL = TOLERANCE_RELATIVE * Var(the corresponding UNRESIDUALIZED rank vector). Scale-free, so it does not depend on the number of pooled cells.
zero_variance_rule.tolerance_justification: Rank data on N pooled cells has worst-case mean-centring round-off of order N*eps*max_rank; at N=1125 that is ~2.8e-10 in magnitude, i.e. ~7.7e-20 in variance. The frozen threshold 1.05e-10 sits about 1.4e9 times ABOVE that numerical floor and about 3.3e12 times BELOW the variance of a genuine non-degenerate residual (measured 3.51e+02 for the D.11 fixture under tau-only conditioning). The separation is unambiguous in both directions.
zero_variance_rule.MAPPED_RHO_rationale: The residualized variable retains no variation from which a conditional association could be established. The statistic is therefore defined as exactly 0.0 - it is NOT NaN, not missing, not skipped, not undefined, and never positive evidence.
zero_variance_rule.MAPPED_P_VALUE_rationale: U2-S2 is a one-sided test of rho > 0. A statistic deterministically mapped to zero cannot be extreme in the positive direction, so the one-sided p-value is 1.0. This is consistent with the frozen bootstrap-inversion formula: every replicate hitting the same case also maps to rho* = 0.0, giving p = (1 + #{rho* <= 0}) / (B + 1) = (1 + B) / (B + 1) = 1.0.
zero_variance_rule.bootstrap_note: Replicates in the zero-variance case are RETAINED with rho* = 0.0. Dropping them would bias the interval and change the effective B.
reporting_required: the count and fraction of bootstrap replicates in the zero-variance case
the observed Var(r_hat) and Var(r_oracle) with the applied TOL
zero_variance_rule.conjunction_consequence: With rho = 0.0 and p = 1.0, the Holm-adjusted p-value is 1.0 and the interval cannot lie entirely above zero, so U2-S2 fails its clause and U2_POSITIVE cannot be declared.

A_scale_agreement.strong_criterion_wording_bound: A CI containing slope = 1 (and intercept 0) is a NON-REJECTION of scale mismatch at this power, NOT proof of scale equivalence. sigma_positivity_rule.name: CALIBRATION_ONLY_POSITIVITY_GUARD
sigma_positivity_rule.problem: III-B fits an unconstrained ridge directly to LINEAR sigma. An unconstrained ridge may return sigma_hat < 0, most plausibly at low q and low tau where the oracle sigma is smallest (the minimum oracle sigma over the primary support is 3.8782034e-4 blocks at RIGHT_TO_LEFT, q_low, tau = 1). Negative sigma_hat does not invalidate any statistic built on raw predictions, but it makes Gaussian interval construction, Gaussian NLL, log(sigma) and any density score undefined.
sigma_positivity_rule.EPS_justification: 1e-4 blocks is a purely numerical and physical positivity guard. It is 3.878x below the smallest oracle sigma anywhere on the primary support (3.8782034e-4 blocks: RIGHT_TO_LEFT, q_low, tau = 1), 13.8x below the smallest LEFT_TO_RIGHT oracle sigma (1.3805264551e-3), and 1000x below the frozen minimum within-identity target SD of 0.10 blocks. It cannot manufacture, mask or reverse any uncertainty signal.

authority_amendment_4.name: Capture liveness successor rule
authority_amendment_4.statement: Renderer liveness must be established independently of the scientific visibility condition being measured. A scientific P0 condition must not be required to demonstrate framebuffer inequality merely because the target changes PRESENT/ABSENT state.
authority_amendment_4.defect_resolved: 7.10f required the target present/absent transitions to demonstrate a framebuffer change on every unit, while also recognising that an opaque condition legitimately renders pixel-identical frames with a hidden target. The nine frozen placements all lie inside the as-built wall extent, so an opaque wall occludes the target at every placement and 18 of the 252 P0 units refused on physically correct observations.
changes: 4a a fixed ENGINEERING_ONLY pre-capture liveness witness (NO_WALL, fixed visible calibration position, PRESENT->ABSENT->PRESENT) is required before each scientific capture unit
4b scientific PRESENT/ABSENT framebuffer equality is diagnostic only and is never, by itself, CAPTURE_STALE_FRAME
4c the rule is uniform across conditions: no material-specific exemption, no L4 special case, no inference from opacity, RVE, ladder or model behaviour
4d witness artifacts are ENGINEERING_ONLY and excluded from every scientific consumer
